notes.title: Patch 2 - Upscalers, Performance and Quality!
notes.content:
ːsteamhappyː Time for Patch 2 ːsteamhappyː

In Patch 2 I've focussed mainly on improving quality & stability! 
By updating you can expect:

[list]

[*] Improved visual fidelity
[*] Improved texture quality
[*] Improved voice acting
[*] Fixed various small bugs in quests
[*] Various quality of life improvements
[*] Overal performance improvements
[*] Added Anti-Aliasing & Upscaling options
[*] Update to Nvidia DLSS 4
[*] Added Intel XeSS 2 Upscaling
[*] Added Qualcomm Snapdragon GSR 2 Upscaling
[*] World premiere of the new Arm ASR Upscaling for Unity!
[/list]

As you can see, I've gone haywire with adding upscaling options! When adding the graphical option to select your own prefered upscaler I thought, why not add them all. And if you don't like to use upscalers, you're now able to disable them all together ːsteamhappyː

Happy playing!

Dominic
The Naked Dev

notes.title: Patch 1 - Performance Improvements!
notes.content:
ːsteamhappyː It's official, the first patch, version 1.05, one of many to come, has been uploaded to Steam! ːsteamhappyː

This patch has been focused on [b]performance, performance, performance[/b]! So, after updating you can expect:

[list]
[*] Engine update to Unity 6
[*] Many small quality of life improvements
[*] Performance improvements
[*] More stable framerates (less frame hitching)
[*] Improved shadow quality
[*] Improved draw distance
[*] Improved loading speeds
[*] Improved texture streaming
[*] Decreased memory usage
[*] Updated to FSR 3.1
[*] Updated to DLSS 3.10
[/list]

Needless to say, in the past month and a half I’ve only worked on improving the game’s performance, but now I’ve arrived at the edge of the capabilities of the current, so called “renderpipeline”. A few years ago, Unity introduced a new renderpipeline called the “Universal Renderpipeline”, and I in all my wisdom decided NOT to use it back then, because as all things new & Unity it was very buggy.

But nowadays it’s much better than the legacy version, and so it’s time to upgrade! If you’re interested in following this process, I will be livestreaming the first few hours of absolutely destroying City of Springs, because as Val would say: “You have to first break things to upgrade them… and when things are broken, you fix it!”.

So join up, tomorrow, Friday the 21st at 16:00 CET, to watch the city of Rivetton be utterly destroyed and get all PINK, and hopefully get build back up again

You can it watch here: [b][url=https://www.youtube.com/@The-Naked-Dev/streams]https://www.youtube.com/@The-Naked-Dev/streams[/url][/b]
(or [b]subscribe [/b]to the channel and you’ll get a very nice message from YouTube when the stream has started!)

Hope to see you tomorrow!

Dominic
The Naked Dev

notes.title: Play the first chapter!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We would like to inform you that a [b]new closed alpha test[/b] has started for City of Springs! 

We’ve worked hard on the game since the last time some of you had the chance of playing it. Now, we got the [b]full first chapter of the game[/b] available for you to try and play.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42118383/03c97425b651ca5009553598bd6bfa12b6fc7d35.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42118383/03c97425b651ca5009553598bd6bfa12b6fc7d35.png[/img][/url]

From [b]2 March[/b] until [b]12 March[/b] you have the opportunity to participate in this new test. 
Take your time while playing and of course, enjoy! We can’t wait to hear what you think, positive or negative, so we can make City of Springs the best game possible. If you could provide [url=https://forms.gle/71Nzj8cm5DJdxpB38]this form[/url] with your feedback after your playtest, that would be greatly appreciated.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42118383/017c0ed8cc083ff99d2ee2bb0dd64ae134dda73a.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42118383/017c0ed8cc083ff99d2ee2bb0dd64ae134dda73a.jpg[/img][/url]

[h3]See you in the City of Springs![/h3]
